name: Camping 101: Enchanting

angles.text: Alliance enchanters traveling through their lands can find Betty Quin in Stormwind for lessons in campcraft.

faq.answer: Enchanters can learn to make magical supplies for camp from Betty Quin in Stormwind. She teaches those who have honed their craft.
Betty Quin teaches skilled enchanters in Stormwind how to make magical items for the road and for leisure.
An Enchanted Lute is a magical instrument that brings music and lifts spirits during camp. It helps travelers face the hardships of the trail.
Enchanters bring magic to camp, making downtime a chance to rest, prepare, and enjoy some music before a hard journey.
faq.q: Why are enchanters valued at a campsite?

aliases: where do i turn in camping 101 enchanting
faq.answer: Find Betty Quin in Stormwind, the capital of the kingdom of Stormwind.
faq.q: Where do I go to complete this task?

aliases: when can i learn enchanted lute
faq.answer: Betty Quin teaches campcraft to enchanters who have shown solid skill in enchanting, including how to make an Enchanted Lute.
faq.q: What skill is needed to learn camping enchanting recipes?

sections.body: Long roads across Azeroth call for more than steel and rations. Comfort and good spirits matter in the wild, too. Enchanters put their craft to work at camp, turning quiet hours into music and rest before the next stretch of trail.
sections.title: Magic on the Trail

sections.body: Betty Quin in Stormwind teaches enchanters to make special items for the campsite. Once they have shown skill in enchanting, she can teach them to craft an Enchanted Lute. Its charms lift spirits around the campfire.
sections.title: Seeking Betty Quin

summary: In Stormwind, Betty Quin teaches enchanters to bring a little magic to the campfire. With an Enchanted Lute, they can lift spirits and help travelers rest along the trail.
